name: Empathy and Environment
description: This course would help the students to internalize environmental sustainability as a way of being, informed by values of empathy, simplicity, responsibility, interdependence and respect for life. With the world facing several environmental challenges, we need to critically examine if we are living better than our forefathers. The students would get to experience the lifestyles of low impact communities such as rural living, tribal practices, Jain ascetics to reduce their own ecological footprint. We would also like to explore nature classrooms, trekking, zero waste challenges to learn about minimalism and simplicity. We would also discuss sustainability as a systems problem and learn to practice planet centred design. The students would articulate their own value-led vision for living well and at a meta level, they may find that living a life in sync with mother nature is better for one's health and wellbeing.
